frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Auditory intake: the reception of an emitted vocal/sonic signal into a perceiver, an intake that inherently positions the receiver for uptake or response (the response itself is always supplied by context, never by the root).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Auditory intake: the reception of an emitted vocal/sonic signal into a perceiver, an intake that inherently positions the receiver for uptake or response (the response itself is always supplied by context, never by the root).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 185 occurrences the root marks one thing: a signal that is sounded reaches and enters a receiver. Form I is the bare intake event — hearing speech (2:75, 58:1), raw sounds (19:98 rikz, 20:108 hams, 21:102 hasis, 67:7 shahiq, 50:42 sayhah), or a circulating report with bi- (12:31, 23:24, 28:36, 38:7). The noun samE names the intake faculty/channel itself, listed alongside sight and heart as an accountable instrument (2:7, 16:78, 17:36, 32:9, 41:20-22, 46:26) and as the access-channel to celestial speech that jinn try to tap (15:18, 26:212, 72:9). samiyE (divine name ~45x, human 76:2) is the standing attribute of that intake — pointedly paired with what is uttered: qawl (58:1), duEa' (3:38, 14:39), tahawur (58:1). Form VIII (istamaEa, 18x) adds deliberate directedness to the intake (7:204, 20:13, 39:18, 46:29); Form V (37:8) adds strained repeated attempts at illicit intake; the intensive sammaEuwna (5:41-42, 9:47) adds habitual avidity; Form IV (15x) causes intake in another (27:80, 30:52, 35:22, 8:23). The covenant formula samiEna wa-'aTaEna (2:285, 24:51) and its inversion wa-EaSayna (2:93, 4:46) prove the residue is intake and not obedience: hearing is coordinated WITH obeying/disobeying as a separate act, so heeding is contextual, not root-borne. Likewise 8:21 (they said samiEna but la yasmaEuwna) grades depth of intake polemically — the root contribution (signal reception) is present in both tokens; the verse denies that the intake was real, it does not use the root for something other than intake.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: I = bare intake; IV = causing intake in another (and the af'il-bihi exclamatory construction in 19:38/18:26 = intensity of intake, not a new sense); V = effortful iterative attempted intake (37:8); VIII = volitional, directed intake (isti- targeting via ila/li); faEEal intensive = habitual avid intake (5:41); faEiyl = standing attribute of intake; masdar/noun samE = the faculty/channel. CONSTRUCTION: bi- + report = intake of secondhand speech (12:31, 23:24); coordination with 'aTaEna/EaSayna assigns response to a separate verb, keeping the root clean; ghayra musmaEin (4:46) is a curse built on the causative, still intake-causation. CONTEXT: heeding-signs uses (10:67, 32:26, 28:71 'afala tasmaEuwna) and the deaf/dead polemic (27:80, 43:40, 6:36, 7:179) let context grade intake from acoustic event to effective reception — the grading is contextual; the intake core is constant. Participants (God, humans, jinn, idols in 26:72, 35:14, 19:42) vary freely without disturbing the residue.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 25:12 — samiEuw laha taghayyuZan wa-zafiyran: "they hear from it fury and roaring." Fury (taghayyuZ) is not itself a sound, so this token could be read as smE covering non-auditory perception, which would break the residue. Resolution stays internal: taghayyuZ is coordinated with zafiyr (an explicit sound) under one verb, and the parallel Fire-passages in the same packet give the Fire an audible voice (67:7 shahiyq "they heard its inhaling roar", 21:102 Hasiys, 50:42). The fury is received through its sonic manifestation — a coordination/zeugma effect at the construction layer, not a shift in root contribution. Second-hardest: 8:21, resolved above as contextual grading of intake depth.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: That the root itself means "heed/obey" (responsive hearing), since samiEna wa-'aTaEna, ismaEuw imperatives (5:108, 64:16), and "the dead do not hear" all involve compliance. Rejected internally: the corpus repeatedly separates intake from response with distinct verbs — samiEna wa-EaSayna (2:93, 4:46) is coherent only if hearing does not itself contain obedience; 63:4 tasmaE li-qawlihim describes intake of hypocrites' speech with zero heeding; 19:98/20:108 apply the root to bare faint sounds where no obedience is possible. The obedience reading is a contextual enrichment of intake, not the residue.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from nearest neighbor roots inside this packet's own verses: nSt (7:204, 46:29 'anSituw) is the silence-posture enabling listening and is coordinated with istamaEa, so it cannot be the same contribution; lqy + samE (50:37 'alqa al-samE) and srq + samE (15:18) treat samE as the channel object that other roots direct or steal — samE is the intake itself, not the orienting act; bSr (constantly paired: al-samiyE al-baSiyr, samE/'abSar lists) is the visual-intake counterpart, confirming smE is modality-specific to sound; 'dhn ('adhan 'ears' in 7:179, 22:46) names the organ, while smE names the reception the organ performs (7:179: ears BY WHICH they do not hear). Falsifiable: a confirmed occurrence using smE for perception with no sonic/vocal signal (e.g., purely visual) would break the residue; none exists in the 185.
internal_discovery.rationale: All 185 confirmed occurrences were individually assessed (78 Form I tokens, 65 nouns including the formulaic samiyE-Ealiym/baSiyr set, 15 Form IV, 18 Form VIII, 1 Form V, 8 ADJ). Every token carries the intake-of-sounded-signal residue once form (causation, volition, intensity), construction (bi-report, exclamatory af'il, coordination with obedience verbs), and context (polemic grading, eschatological scenes, divine attribution) are subtracted. The two genuinely resistant tokens (25:12 zeugma; 8:21 intake-depth polemic) resolve by construction and context respectively, using only packet-internal parallels (67:7, 21:102; 2:93, 63:4). No occurrence required forcing, no occurrence was left unaccounted, and the residue is non-empty, modality-specific, distinctive against nSt/bSr/'dhn/lqy-samE within the packet's own verses, and falsifiable. Universal presence holds.

adversarial_verification.notes: Full coverage: all 185 confirmed occurrences checked against "auditory intake (reception of an emitted vocal/sonic signal into a perceiver)". Every occurrence reconciles after subtracting form/construction/context. V base = direct intake of speech/sound/report (sami'a bi- = intake of a report: 12:31, 23:24, 28:36, 38:7). V(VIII)/V(V) = attentive/directed intake (attention is form residue). V(IV) causative (tusmi'u/yusmi'u/asma'ahum, 27:80, 30:52, 35:22, 43:40, 8:23) = intake caused into an object-perceiver; asmi' bihi/bihim (18:26, 19:38) = exclamation of wonder at perfect hearing. N faculty al-sam' = organ/faculty of intake (16:78, 32:9, 67:23, 2:7, 6:46, 41:20-22). ADJ/N divine name samI' = attribute/capacity of intake, self-glossed at 58:1 ("God heard... God hears... God is samI' baSir"); samI'u l-du'a' (14:39, 3:38) = Hearer of supplication with answering supplied by context. Intensive sammA'un (5:41-42, 9:47) = avid listener/spy = intensive agent of intake, lam = construction. Resistant probes all retain intake as the very thing barred/prohibited/stolen/punned-on: istaraqa s-sam' (15:18), 'ani s-sam' lama'zulun (26:212), yulqun/alqa s-sam' (26:223, 50:37), maqa'id lis-sam' (72:9), la tasma'u li-l-qur'an (41:26), wasma' ghayra musma' (4:46), la yassamma'un (37:8). The "obey/heed/answer/accept" sense is never in the root: it is always a separate conjoined verb (sami'na wa-ata'na 24:51/2:285/5:7; sami'na wa-'asayna 2:93; yastajib... yasma'un 6:36) or a contextual inference from a divine attribute, so the proposal's escape clause ("response supplied by context, never the root") is upheld rather than breached. 2:171 (cattle hear only sound, no comprehension) and 8:23 (turn away if made to hear) positively confirm intake decoupled from uptake. Distinctiveness confirmed by systematic contrastive co-occurrence: smE opposed to baSar (visual modality) and to 'aqala/faqiha/'alima (comprehension) within single verses (2:171, 22:46, 25:44, 7:179), isolating auditory-modality intake as the residue. Falsifiable and not falsified; proper name Isma'il is correctly excluded from targets (appears only in verse_text at 14:39, 2:127, never as an occurrence), so no homonym leakage. No unreconciled occurrence found; root unity holds.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Verse_text has the basmala prepended (a display artifact; QAC does not count it as part of 17:1), but token position 20 maps unambiguously to al-samiE 'the All-Hearing', the standing attribute of intake. The tokenization oddity does not obscure the judgment, so CONSISTENT rather than STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY.
